# Widget Reference

Every widget type Plux documents can use, generated from the descriptors in `schema/widgets/` (`WGT-001`, [ADR-0010](../adr/0010-layered-widget-model.md)). Layer 1 mirrors Flutter widgets with their names and semantics, plus structural primitives; Layer 2 holds Plux components. How each Flutter parameter is supported or why it is excluded is in the [coverage table](../../schema/widgets/COVERAGE.md) (`WGT-003`). Types are written as in the [document model](document-model.md#3-types-and-values); IDs are permanent (`BND-011`).

## Widgets

| Type | Layer | Category | Phase | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
